meta.title: The 17 — Global Supply Chain Map (illustrative)
meta.disclaimer: All locations, statuses, ownership, offtake, capex, power, and permitting fields are best-effort placeholders assembled for scaffolding. Nothing here should be treated as confirmed — every substantive field carries a [[VERIFY]] marker and must be checked against filings/announcements before presenting.
meta.capacity_note: [[INPUT]] Optional per-asset field 'capacity_tpa' (tonnes/year REO-equivalent). When set, the map scales marker size by capacity; when absent, markers default to stage-based sizing. Add real capacities from company filings before presenting.
meta.field_reference: Per-asset optional tear-sheet fields: operator, ticker (e.g. 'NYSE: MP'), ownership_type (public | private | SOE), offtake, capex_financing, power, permitting_esg. Flows below connect assets by id; every flow is [[VERIFY]].
meta.online_year_note: [[VERIFY]] 'online_year' = actual or projected first-production year (2000 = long-operating legacy). All projections are placeholders; confirm against company guidance before presenting. Drives the timeline slider.

jurisdiction_risk.note: [[VERIFY: replace tiers with actual Fraser Institute Investment Attractiveness rankings — as of 2026-07-07]]. Tiers: low / medium / high investment risk (illustrative).

meta.ira_note: [[VERIFY]] IRA/DPA eligibility is approximated by jurisdiction (US + FTA partners incl. Australia, Canada, Japan, Korea, Chile; UK/AUS/CAN under DPA Title III). Per-asset eligibility must be confirmed — sourcing rules apply at the material level, not the flag level.
